name: Harbor Swap
subtitle: Constant-product AMM
description: Example 4 — Uniswap-V2-style AMM: factory, pairs, LP tokens, TWAP, router swaps up to 4 hops. Fee-on-transfer safe by balance-delta accounting.
long_description: Three-layer constant-product AMM. The factory holds the brake (new pairs, deposits and swaps stop under brake 1; removals stay open). Pairs enforce the k invariant themselves with fee-adjusted balance checks, measure every inflow by actual balance delta so fee-on-transfer tokens never strand funds, and maintain cumulative TWAP prices. The router is stateless: optimal-ratio liquidity provisioning, deadline-enforced swaps, and an observed-input variant for fee-on-transfer paths. Swap traffic costs ~32 state units per trade - no new slots.
